# Offline handout fonts

Unmodified DejaVu Serif and DejaVu Sans 2.37 (regular, bold, italic/oblique).
Source: https://github.com/dejavu-fonts/dejavu-fonts/releases/tag/version_2_37
Archive: dejavu-fonts-ttf-2.37.zip
SHA-256: 7576310b219e04159d35ff61dd4a4ec4cdba4f35c00e002a136f00e96a908b0a

The accompanying LICENSE.txt is required with redistributions. Fonts are
embedded in handout PDFs and loaded locally for matching canvas previews.
No Google Fonts, remote font loading, operating-system font redistribution,
or additional JavaScript runtime dependency is involved.
